description: QIF quality-gate negative fixture corpus. Each file is an invalid package that a conformant verifier must reject with an error containing errorIncludes. Generated from tools/fixtures/quality-gate-cases.mjs; do not edit by hand.

negatives.rule: evaluation target required fields
negatives.errorIncludes: must include non-empty string domain

negatives.rule: evaluation target stakeholder impact

negatives.rule: quality intent loss boundary severity

negatives.errorIncludes: references missing quality aspect

negatives.rule: retention policy evidence types resolve

negatives.rule: evidence type must be covered by cited retention policy
negatives.errorIncludes: is not covered by retention policy

negatives.rule: confidential retention policy requires restricted access
negatives.errorIncludes: confidential evidence must use need-to-know or regulatory-controlled access.

negatives.rule: restricted retention policy requires strong integrity protection
negatives.errorIncludes: restricted evidence must use signed-artifact or immutable-log integrity protection.

negatives.rule: retention policies must be used

negatives.rule: quality reports are required

negatives.rule: quality report scores stay summary-only

negatives.rule: quality report score gate decision resolves
negatives.errorIncludes: references missing gate decision

negatives.rule: quality report score evidence decomposes from gate verdicts
negatives.errorIncludes: is not decomposed from the report's gate verdict evidence.

negatives.rule: quality report section evidence decomposes from gate verdicts
negatives.errorIncludes: is not decomposed from the report's gate verdict evidence.

negatives.rule: AI finding evidence final status is required
negatives.errorIncludes: finalStatus must be one of

negatives.rule: AI finding evidence reproducible is boolean
negatives.errorIncludes: reproducible must be boolean.

negatives.rule: confirmed AI finding evidence requires reproduction, false-positive check, and impact confirmation
negatives.errorIncludes: cannot be confirmed until reproducible, falsePositiveChecked, and impactConfirmed are true.

negatives.rule: evidence trust status is required
negatives.errorIncludes: trust status must be one of draft, verified, stale, rejected.

negatives.errorIncludes: trust verified status requires at least one source.

negatives.errorIncludes: value must be a number.

negatives.rule: quantitative record quantity type
negatives.errorIncludes: quantityType must be one of

negatives.errorIncludes: must be interpreted as evidence-only, not as quality itself.

negatives.errorIncludes: references missing retained evidence

negatives.rule: quantitative record links quality intent
negatives.errorIncludes: references missing quality intent

negatives.rule: automated counts sum to executedCount

negatives.rule: gate rule required evidence types
negatives.errorIncludes: must include requiredEvidenceTypes.

negatives.rule: evaluation timing rule linked intents resolve
negatives.errorIncludes: references missing quality intent

negatives.rule: evaluation timing rule timing enum
negatives.errorIncludes: timing must be one of

negatives.rule: completed evaluation timing decision cites evidence

negatives.rule: waived evaluation timing decision requires governance
negatives.errorIncludes: must include at least one governance trigger.

negatives.rule: gate decision verdict enum
negatives.errorIncludes: decision must be Go, Conditional Go, No-Go, or Pending.

negatives.rule: gate decision residual risks
negatives.errorIncludes: must include residualRisks.

negatives.rule: verdict confidence reproduces from evidence and policy
negatives.errorIncludes: confidence must reproduce from evidence inputs and policy

negatives.rule: decision confidence reproduces from verdict confidences
negatives.errorIncludes: confidence must reproduce from verdict confidences and policy

negatives.rule: one verdict per gated intent
negatives.errorIncludes: has duplicate verdicts for quality intent

negatives.rule: achieved verdict cites supporting evidence
negatives.errorIncludes: is achieved but cites no supporting evidence.

negatives.rule: gated intent covered by an evaluation perspective
negatives.errorIncludes: gates an intent that no evaluation perspective covers.

negatives.rule: every intent a cited gate rule protects has a verdict
negatives.errorIncludes: records no verdict for its protected intent

negatives.rule: Go/Conditional Go satisfies each cited rule's required evidence types
negatives.errorIncludes: lacks required evidence type

negatives.rule: conflicting evidence forces a governance trigger
negatives.errorIncludes: must include a conflicting-evidence governance trigger when verdict evidence conflicts.

negatives.rule: low-confidence verdict forces a governance trigger
negatives.errorIncludes: must include a low-confidence governance trigger when a verdict confidence is low.

negatives.rule: high-severity boundary on only low-independence evidence forces governance
negatives.errorIncludes: must include a weak-evidence governance trigger

negatives.rule: Go blocked when high-severity boundary rests only on low-independence evidence
negatives.errorIncludes: cannot be Go when a high-severity loss boundary is supported only by low-independence evidence.

negatives.rule: Go blocked while a high-severity boundary verdict is not-achieved/inconclusive
negatives.errorIncludes: cannot be Go while a high-severity loss boundary verdict is not-achieved or inconclusive.

negatives.rule: Go blocked while a high-severity governance trigger is open
negatives.errorIncludes: cannot be Go while high-severity governance triggers remain open

negatives.rule: Go/Conditional Go includes a rollback plan
negatives.errorIncludes: must include non-empty string rollbackPlan.

negatives.rule: Conditional Go lists explicit conditions
negatives.errorIncludes: is Conditional Go and must include explicit conditions.

negatives.rule: each Conditional Go condition names an owner
negatives.errorIncludes: must include non-empty string owner.

negatives.rule: No-Go cites a violated boundary or gate rule
negatives.errorIncludes: is No-Go and must cite a violated loss boundary or gate rule.

negatives.rule: Pending lists the missing evidence
negatives.errorIncludes: is Pending and must list the missing evidence.

negatives.rule: governance trigger required fields
negatives.errorIncludes: must include non-empty string requiredAction.

negatives.rule: non-open trigger links a governance event
negatives.errorIncludes: is not open and must link to a resultingGovernanceEventRef.

negatives.rule: governance event required fields
negatives.errorIncludes: must include non-empty string decidedBy.

negatives.rule: high-severity post-release incident links an improvement action
negatives.errorIncludes: records a high-severity incident and must link at least one improvement action.

negatives.rule: improvement action is cross-referenced by its source review
negatives.errorIncludes: that does not list it in improvementActionRefs.

negatives.rule: improvement action links its source post-release review
negatives.errorIncludes: references missing source post-release review

negatives.rule: traceability link source resolves
negatives.errorIncludes: references missing sourceRef

negatives.rule: traceability link target resolves
negatives.errorIncludes: references missing targetRef

negatives.rule: verifier boundary disclaims semantic truth
